_comment: Risk Officer and Signal Engine configuration.
All dollar amounts in CENTS unless the key ends in _prob, _min, or _rate.
fee_rate VERIFIED 2026-07-27 against Kalshi's official fee-schedule PDF:
taker fee = round_up(0.07 x C x P x (1-P)) per contract — matches this config.
Maker/resting orders: 0.0175 with M=0 default (usually free).
Our feeCeil rounds up to a whole cent — slightly conservative vs Kalshi's
centicent rounding, so computed edges are understated, never overstated.
max_age_min bounds SNAPSHOT age (collector writes every ~4 min).
max_obs_age_min bounds METAR OBSERVATION age — METARs arrive ~hourly
(typically :51-:53 past the hour), so 75 min tolerates a normal cycle
